description: Alle Repository-Skills stehen jedem Copilot-Run automatisch zur Verfügung. Eine Auswahl ist nicht nötig – Copilot entscheidet anhand des Prompts, welche Skills es verwendet.

skills.name: anycubic-kobra-s1-ace-pro-profile
skills.description: Anycubic Kobra S1 Combo + ACE Pro defaults and constraints for STL/3MF authoring and editing.

skills.name: blender-assisted-modeling
skills.description: Use local Blender through a controlled MCP workflow for organic or visual geometry while preserving measured datums and validating every exported mesh.

skills.name: create-ascii-stl
skills.description: Create ASCII STL files using print-safe defaults for Anycubic Kobra S1 Combo + ACE Pro.

skills.name: edit-stl-transform
skills.description: Edit STL geometry (scale/rotate/translate/split/merge) while preserving printability constraints.

skills.name: image-relief-vectorize
skills.description: Turn reference images into a relief/height-map aided vector outline before building 3D geometry.

skills.name: multimaterial-assembly-packaging
skills.description: Package complex models as an assembled multi-state view 3MF and one consolidated printable 3MF, preferring separately printed keyed color parts to reduce purge waste.

skills.name: optimize-stl-for-print
skills.description: Optimize an existing STL for FDM printing on the Anycubic Kobra S1 - orientation, overhangs, wall and hole compensation, elephant foot, bed layout and material estimate.

skills.name: orcaslicer-print-validation
skills.description: Perform the final OrcaSlicer printability gate and record the exact profile, print time, material use, supports, warnings, and preview evidence.

skills.name: orcaslicer-project-workflow
skills.description: Slice and inspect this repository's STL/3MF outputs with standard OrcaSlicer through the pinned local MCP server.

skills.name: orcaslicer-support-minimization
skills.description: Minimize supports in delivered STL/3MF print projects by comparing controlled OrcaSlicer orientation candidates while preserving project semantics; use when a final print project needs support-focused orientation and placement review without source-geometry edits.

skills.name: partial-rebuild-instead-of-mutate
skills.description: Replace unstable local mutation with a controlled partial rebuild from frozen datums and a constrained scope.

skills.name: photo-anchor-candidate-fit
skills.description: Refine a model toward image references with frozen datums, landmark alignment, and candidate sweeps to avoid iterative drift.

skills.name: research-part-specs
skills.description: Find real published dimensions for a part before modeling it, cite the source, and record the numbers in a measurement doc instead of guessing from a photo.

skills.name: research-reusable-3d-assets
skills.description: Search for reusable 3D model assets before building from scratch, verify licensing and attribution, and choose reuse, hybrid rebuild, or original construction.

skills.name: reversible-fdm-joints
skills.description: Select, design, and validate strong glue-free FDM assembly joints, preferring serviceable removable connections and checking load paths and insertion sweeps.

skills.name: stl-create-edit-interview
skills.description: Guided question flow for STL/3MF authoring/editing choices (wall strategy, mesh pattern, infill strategy, and fit intent).

skills.name: stl-from-image-measurements
skills.description: Create or edit printable geometry from user-provided images and measurements. Use for identifying objects from photos, indexing reference photos into a numbered contact sheet before reading them, researching existing 3D models with subagents, downloading or extracting model properties when possible, recreating missing geometry, combining objects into one output, applying requested spacing/relations/dimensions, and validating against Anycubic Kobra S1 Combo + ACE Pro print constraints before finalizing.

skills.name: validate-stl-mesh
skills.description: Validate STL meshes for manifold correctness and FDM printability readiness.

skills.name: visual-hull-envelope-fit
skills.description: Use multiple silhouettes or views to constrain the outer envelope before rebuilding or refining a model.
